cases.prompt: Review schema.sql before we go live.
expectations: Flags the missing foreign key from orders.customer_id to customers.id and asks for intended ON DELETE behavior
Flags FLOAT for money and recommends an exact numeric type
Flags missing NOT NULL and uniqueness on customers.email
Raises TIMESTAMP without time zone as a question or risk

cases.prompt: orders has 200 million rows. Write a migration that adds a required status column.
expectations: Uses an expand-and-contract approach: add nullable or defaulted column, backfill in batches, then add the constraint
Calls out locking risks and uses online options where the database supports them
Does not run the migration against a shared or production database

cases.prompt: Write a README section explaining how to run the tests.
